name: Hurricane
primary:
A tornado rises at the aimed spot and slowly follows your crosshair.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky: at least 10 blocks of air above the target, so it fails in caves and under roofs.
The funnel pulls in and spins every creature within 9 blocks. Those caught in the core are lifted into the air and take, twice a second:
• Damage 3 ❤ arcane
• Wet for 5 s
The funnel tears up grass, flowers and leaves on its path. You are not pulled.
self_description:
On you:
• Slow falling for 15 s
• Speed IV for 15 s
